name: One-Time Settlement (OTS) Negotiation Campaign
description: Special resolution offer call providing a discounted principal payment to close long-overdue accounts
goal: Present a one-time settlement discount offer to resolve the defaulted loan account amicably.
scriptFlow: Greet customer and acknowledge past payment difficulties empatheticly.
Introduce the limited-time One-Time Settlement (OTS) offer approved by management.
Clearly state the discounted settlement amount vs the total debt amount.
Emphasize the validity deadline and benefits (NOC issuance, closing the file).
Get commitment or agreement to receive the payment link.
constraints: Do not offer discounts lower than the authorized settlementAmount.
Clearly state that settlement will be reported to credit bureau as 'Settled'.
Ensure offer conditions are communicated clearly.
escalationTriggers: Customer asks for even lower settlement amount
Customer demands immediate CIBIL clear certificate
